entities.summary: Mario Fischer is an Austrian ice hockey player for Vienna Capitals in the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). He joined the Capitals from EC Red Bull Salzburg on April 26, 2011. He participated with the Austrian national teamat the 2015 IIHF World Championship.
